supersedes: The wave-0A NOT_RUN receipt (PR #26), which ruled this document out as 'case-invention' on the belief that 'the old MewAgent codebase' was a different, unreachable system. Ground truth correction 2026-07-29: Mew IS the local Ideaflow codebase (D:/VSCode Projects/Ideaflow/*-mew), so the document's expected-output trees are owner-authored acceptance expectations for agent behavior over exactly the graph this migration targets. The 0A receipt was honest about what it knew; its premise was wrong, and it is superseded, not deleted.
harvestRules: Commands and expected trees are carried verbatim from the page's 'Ideal Result Output with Indentation Level' section. Structural assertions were derived mechanically from each tree (node presence, parentage, ordering); illustrative prose inside tree nodes (e.g. the Web3 outline text) is marked non-falsifiable rather than paraphrased into testability.

cases.command: /mewagent Research Web3 and its core components
falsifiableAssertions: A work-product root node titled with the research topic is created under the MewAgent command node's parent scope
The outline is a multi-level tree (>= 2 levels below the root work product)
Thought/progress events render as child nodes of the MewAgent command node, in order
A terminal completion node is present
State persists as __MewAgentMemory__ and __MewAgentPatterns__ nodes containing parseable JSON with episodicMemory / pattern entries naming the tool sequence
nonFalsifiable: The specific outline content (Web3 definitions etc.) — illustrative, depends on live web search and model output

evaluation.reason: The migration slice's agent surface is retrieval-only (source-bound answers over the store); it implements none of research_and_create_notes, create_node, or streaming child-node UI. Additionally the graph is empty until the owner's export is imported.

cases.blockAnchor: Example 2: Find and Organize Existing Notes
cases.command: /mewagent Find all my notes about meetings and organize them into a "Project Meetings" folder
falsifiableAssertions: Given the Before tree (5 notes under Project Alpha, 3 meeting-related), a new 'Project Meetings' node exists after the run
Exactly the 3 meeting-related notes are re-parented under it; the other 2 remain in place
The agent trace records find_nodes, create_node, and 3 move_node calls in that order
Memory/pattern state nodes are updated with the action sequence

evaluation.reason: Deterministic and fully falsifiable given the fixture Before-tree, but requires an agent with find/create/move tools; the migration slice's surface is retrieval-only. Runnable the moment the CRUD toolset exists.

cases.blockAnchor: Example 3: Finding and Linking Related Concepts
cases.command: /mewagent I wrote about "Mamba architecture" and "State Space Models". Find them and link them with an explanation.
falsifiableAssertions: Both existing notes are found (no duplicates created)
A new Connection node with explanatory content is created under 'Mamba architecture'
A relatedTo relation exists from the connection node to 'State Space Models'
The agent trace records find_nodes, create_node, add_relation

evaluation.reason: Requires find/create/add_relation tools absent from the retrieval-only slice, and a populated graph.

unresolvedShare: 0 of 3 cases are unresolved as to falsifiability (all three carry mechanical assertions); 3 of 3 are NOT_RUN for capability and data reasons stated per case. The >20% unresolved kill condition does not trigger.
boundary: This harvest establishes that owner-authored, falsifiable acceptance cases EXIST for agent-over-graph behavior. It does not run them, and it does not claim they cover import integrity — no case in the document addresses the export/import path itself.
